# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

We've published our results for the first quarter of 2026. Learn more about how we performed and

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

## Sustainability

We’re always finding new and exciting ways to make our products more sustainable and longer lasting.
Because paint matters – to us, to you and the world around us.

[ Find out more ][59]

## Driving innovation

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation
and recent developments in paints and coatings technology. 

[ Find out more ][60]

#### Collaborations

Discover how we play a progressive role in cross-industry coalitions and consortia to help create a
more sustainable future.
[ Learn more ][61]

#### Partnerships

Meet our partners and learn how we’re rocking the art world with the Rijksmuseum and accelerating
innovation with McLaren.
[ Learn more ][62]

#### Initiatives

ordinary extraordinary.

### Forefront of Innovation

### Breakthrough Performance

When it comes to building durability, increasing performance or enhancing appearance, PPG's refinish

Learn More

### Tomorrow Realized

Leading manufacturers trust PPG’s global color stylists, chemists and technical application experts

Learn More

### Leading the Pack

For decades, PPG’s research and development experts have created coatings that have made products
better across nearly every industry, from food and beverage, to cosmetics and personal care, to
paints and chemicals. 

Learn More

## Protective & Marine Coatings

### Unrivaled Performance

Developing products that protect customers’ assets in some of the world’s most demanding conditions
and environments, including civil infrastructure, offshore, petrochemical, power, marine new-build,
marine dry dock and marine sea stock.

Learn More

## Traffic Solutions

### Performance that protects

The broad, global portfolio of pavement markings and traffic safety solutions includes paint,
thermoplastics and other advanced traffic technologies, which help keep motorists, cyclists, road
workers and pedestrians safe in our communities.

### SOLVING COMPLEX PROBLEMS WITH UNIQUE SOLUTIONS

## Optical Monomers and Coatings


Eyeglass lens technologies that enhance and protect vision.

Learn More

## PPG TESLIN® Substrate


A high-performance material used for product labels, ID cards and more.

Learn More

## Filtration Technologies


An innovative new technology that make the sustainable recovery of industrial process water and
wastewater more efficient and economical.

Learn More

### Protect Your Garage Floor With Rust-Oleum EpoxyShield Garage Floor Coating

Seal and protect your garage floor with Rust-Oleum's DIY epoxy garage floor kit.

Rust-Oleum EpoxyShield Garage Floor Coating rolls on like paint and dries into a protective barrier
that will last for years. Two people can complete a garage floor coating project in just a weekend.

EpoxyShield Garage Floor Coating applies in just one coat and protects your garage floor against
cracking, salt, and stains. The durable finish is easy to clean and comes with a no-peel promise.

Whether you want to improve the look of your garage floor or protect it from future spills, leaks or
damage, EpoxyShield Garage Floor Coating is the DIY solution you can trust.

Rust-Oleum Industrial Choice 1600 Multi-Purpose Spray Paint is the choice of professionals for

angle, allowing you to paint all sides of any object.

Spray Paint is available in 44 colors.

cracking, there's a Zinsser primer for the job.

## About Tikkurila

Tikkurila is a leading Nordic paint company. We are a pioneer of sustainable painting, surface
treatment, and use of colors, and we do it responsibly. We drive sustainable beauty, well-being of
people, and longer life of surfaces through our work and products, by using the limited resources of
nature and society in a sustainable manner.

For decades, Tikkurila has been developing and promoting high-quality and user-friendly surface
treatment solutions that are safe for both people and the environment.

## About Tikkurila

Tikkurila is a leading Nordic paint company. We are a pioneer of sustainable painting, surface
treatment, and use of colors, and we do it responsibly. We drive sustainable beauty, well-being of
people, and longer life of surfaces through our work and products, by using the limited resources of
nature and society in a sustainable manner.

For decades, Tikkurila has been developing and promoting high-quality and user-friendly surface
treatment solutions that are safe for both people and the environment.

Experience the difference with our industry-leading refinish products ranging from surface
preparation to undercoats, basecoats, clearcoats, color-matching technologies and accessories. As
the leader in the refinish market we are supporting body shops around the world and reshaping the

[Learn about our Refinish products][6]

We are leading the way in light vehicle and commercial vehicle coatings for original equipment
manufacturers through advanced technologies that protect vehicle exteriors and interiors, insulate
electric motors, increase productivity in the paint shop, and add beauty and color. Our Mobility
solutions comprise Axalta's best-in-class basecoats and clearcoats for color and beautification
along with primers, electrocoats and powder applications for surface protection.

[Learn about our Mobility coatings][7]



## **Industrial**

Our performance coatings are ideal for a wide variety of industrial applications. Our liquid,
electrocoat and powder coating solutions serve an array of industrial segments including those
manufacturing industrial and electrical system components, oil and gas pipelines, wood applications,
agricultural, construction and earth moving equipment, rail cars, structural steel, and sports
equipment.

#### Latest Video

#### Who we are

At [Belzona][184], our combination of cutting-edge research and development allows us to develop the
latest in [polymer systems][185]. Alongside the unrivalled experience of our people, we can meet the
ever-changing and challenging demands of industry.

We are committed to providing bespoke solutions, technical support and on-site assistance tailored
to each client's specific needs. Available through a [global network of Distributors][186],
supported by our headquarters in [UK, USA, Canada and Thailand][187], our engineered solutions come
with international accreditations and a proven track record in performance.

Belzona provides a [truly global service][188], supplying repair and refurbishment services, coating
inspection and application training on a local level. This is all to one purpose; to ensure our
clients have the best materials to protect their plant and equipment for the long term, reducing
downtime and lowering maintenance costs.

#### What we do

Specialising in the design and manufacture of repair composite materials and protective coatings for
machinery, equipment, buildings and structures, Belzona offers the solution to an extensive range of
engineering problems and repair situations.

Simple, safe and effective solutions allow us to assist with demanding projects by providing
benefits rarely found elsewhere, including minimised downtime, reduced health and safety risks and
simple application techniques.

When making an investment in Belzona technology, you get more than just the product. An intrinsic
part of Belzona's success is our commitment to not only providing high-performance solutions, but
always going above and beyond as a 'Product Plus' service provider. Whether it's tailor-made product
specifications, onsite training, ongoing technical support or aftercare, we pride ourselves in
providing a comprehensive support package to fulfil all of our clients' needs.

To discover [Belzona's products][189], the [industries we serve][190] or specific details on our
[application areas][191], [contact us][192] directly or [find your local Distributor][193].

#### Latest Video

#### Who we are

At [Belzona][184], our combination of cutting-edge research and development allows us to develop the
latest in [polymer systems][185]. Alongside the unrivalled experience of our people, we can meet the
ever-changing and challenging demands of industry.

We are committed to providing bespoke solutions, technical support and on-site assistance tailored
to each client's specific needs. Available through a [global network of Distributors][186],
supported by our headquarters in [UK, USA, Canada and Thailand][187], our engineered solutions come
with international accreditations and a proven track record in performance.

Belzona provides a [truly global service][188], supplying repair and refurbishment services, coating
inspection and application training on a local level. This is all to one purpose; to ensure our
clients have the best materials to protect their plant and equipment for the long term, reducing
downtime and lowering maintenance costs.

#### What we do

Specialising in the design and manufacture of repair composite materials and protective coatings for
machinery, equipment, buildings and structures, Belzona offers the solution to an extensive range of
engineering problems and repair situations.

Simple, safe and effective solutions allow us to assist with demanding projects by providing
benefits rarely found elsewhere, including minimised downtime, reduced health and safety risks and
simple application techniques.

When making an investment in Belzona technology, you get more than just the product. An intrinsic
part of Belzona's success is our commitment to not only providing high-performance solutions, but
always going above and beyond as a 'Product Plus' service provider. Whether it's tailor-made product
specifications, onsite training, ongoing technical support or aftercare, we pride ourselves in
providing a comprehensive support package to fulfil all of our clients' needs.

To discover [Belzona's products][189], the [industries we serve][190] or specific details on our
[application areas][191], [contact us][192] directly or [find your local Distributor][193].

### EXBA18V-80
* High-power tabless cell technology – provides lower inner resistance for reduced battery heating,
  increased power, longer runtime and optimized performance

  120% longer runtime** than the core18v® 4 ah battery (gba18v40)

  compared to non-coolpack™ bosch 18v batteries

* Brushless motor – delivers efficient power and a 23.6 ft/s chain speed for fast, consistent

# Ordering Paint Online: Frequently Asked Questions

*[▼How do I place an order for Store Pickup?][234]*
  Once you are ready to checkout, head over to the Cart icon at the top right of your screen. Choose
  "Store Pickup" and then select the location, date and time you wish to collect your order.
*[◄What is the average lead time for Store Pickup Orders?][235]*
  Orders can be placed for Store Pickup at any Catalina Paint Store location. Our team can have your
  paint order ready for pickup within 1 hour.
*[◄Do you offer Local Delivery?][236]*
  Yes! Catalina Paint offers delivery within a 7 mile radius around each Catalina Paints location.
  Once you are ready to check-out, head to the Cart icon at the top right of your screen. Select
  "Local Delivery" and enter your zipcode to see if you are eligible.
*[◄How fast can you deliver my paint?][237]*
  Our current lead time for local delivery orders is 6 hours. When you are ready to checkout, head
  to the Cart and select "Local Delivery", enter your zipcode to ensure you are eligible and then
  choose your preferred delivery date and time slot.
*[◄Do you offer Free Delivery?][238]*
  Yes! All orders above $500 are delivered FREE. Order below $500 can be delivered for a $50
  delivery fee.
*[◄Do you have any products available that are not on the website?][239]*
  Yes. The products displayed on our online store represent only a small sample of what we carry
  in-store. To shop a wider range of products, please visit or call your nearest Catalina Paints
  Location.

# Ordering Paint Online: Frequently Asked Questions

*[▼How do I place an order for Store Pickup?][234]*
  Once you are ready to checkout, head over to the Cart icon at the top right of your screen. Choose
  "Store Pickup" and then select the location, date and time you wish to collect your order.
*[◄What is the average lead time for Store Pickup Orders?][235]*
  Orders can be placed for Store Pickup at any Catalina Paint Store location. Our team can have your
  paint order ready for pickup within 1 hour.
*[◄Do you offer Local Delivery?][236]*
  Yes! Catalina Paint offers delivery within a 7 mile radius around each Catalina Paints location.
  Once you are ready to check-out, head to the Cart icon at the top right of your screen. Select
  "Local Delivery" and enter your zipcode to see if you are eligible.
*[◄How fast can you deliver my paint?][237]*
  Our current lead time for local delivery orders is 6 hours. When you are ready to checkout, head
  to the Cart and select "Local Delivery", enter your zipcode to ensure you are eligible and then
  choose your preferred delivery date and time slot.
*[◄Do you offer Free Delivery?][238]*
  Yes! All orders above $500 are delivered FREE. Order below $500 can be delivered for a $50
  delivery fee.
*[◄Do you have any products available that are not on the website?][239]*
  Yes. The products displayed on our online store represent only a small sample of what we carry
  in-store. To shop a wider range of products, please visit or call your nearest Catalina Paints
  Location.

and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

Bringing color to the world for more than 150 years

# A Global Leader in Paints and Coatings

The Sherwin-Williams Company delivers the best in paint and coatings products to the world. Every
day, our more than 64,000 employees provide the energy and experience to build on our track record
of success – enabling us to innovate and grow in new and exciting ways. With our people as the
foundation of our Company, we offer industry-leading innovation, value-added service and expertise,
and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

 

Sherwin-Williams has one of the industry’s most recognized portfolios of branded and private-label
products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

 

Additional brands are sold through leading mass merchandisers, home centers, independent paint
dealers, hardware stores, automotive retailers, and industrial distributors across North America and
in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

# The FREE science and technology book

[CCD chip from a webcam.]

Want to know why giant ships can float, how your earbuds make music, what graphene is, or how
windows can clean themselves? You've come to the right place! Here you'll find simple explanations
you can really understand—hurrah!

## Hard stuff... made simple!

[Model of a steam turbine at Think Tank science museum, Birmingham, England.]

Explain that Stuff is an online book written by science writer [Chris Woodford][9] (author of many
popular science books for adults and children). It includes over 400 easy-to-understand articles,
richly illustrated with over 4000 photos, artworks, and animations, covering how things work,
cutting-edge science, cool gadgets, and computers. We take the "pain" from explain and the "tough"
out of stuff! There's more information on this website than in your average expensive science book,
it's 100% human written (absolutely no "AI slop"), it's continually updated, and it's completely
free to use! Explain that Stuff also helps to support [curriculum learning][10] (conventional STEM
education and home-schooling).

## How to use this site

There are five simple ways to find what you want:
1. [A-Z index][11]: Browse articles by name.
2. [Timeline][12]: Find inventions by date.
3. [Random][13]: Discover something new.
4. [Search][14]: Use the search engine (at the top of each page).
5. [Teaching guide][15]: Browse study topics.

## What's new?

Some of our newest and most recently updated articles...

[Chromatography makes ink smudge on wet paper.]

### [Chromatography][16]

One of the most important techniques for separating and analyzing chemicals... is 120 years old!

[Dark red sunrise over Dorset, England.]

### [Solar cells][17]

How did solar become the world's favourite new form of power... and what does the future hold for
it?

[How a hybrid car works.]

### [Electric cars][18]

Are they as good as the hype? Are they as clean and green as people claim? Why are they taking so
long to catch on?

[Concept of artificial intelligence: an AI dummy superimposed on a green circuit board.]

### [Artificial intelligence][19]

Can we imagine a world where computers are smart enough not to need us? Is "human intelligence" a
good starting point for designing useful machines?

[The force of gravity is slightly greater at the equator than at the poles airplane.]

### [Gravity][20]

It's taken over two millenia for people to understand how gravity holds the universe together. What
do we know so far about this most mysterious of forces?

[Orange Schlieren photograph of two supersonic jets flying upward]

### [History of flight][21]

Planes can trace their history back thousands of years to ancient myths and legends. Why have humans
always dreamed of soaring to the sky... and why did it take us so long?

[Giant pulley wheels in a large crane]

### [Cranes][22]

The science behind cranes is easy to understand, but why are there so many different types? How much
can they lift... and what stops them toppling over?

[Aristotle pictured at the National Academy of Sciences, Washington, D.C.]

### [History of electricity][23]

Electricity is an ancient science that powers our modern world. Why did it take so long to figure
out how it works and put it to practical use? Find out in our sparky story of electric power!

[Black laptop computer loading software from an open red DVD]

### [Software][24]

Computers are wonderful machines you can reprogram to do almost anything. Learn more about
algorithms, computer languages, and the basic principles of coding in our simple guide.

[Silverback gorilla eating bamboo.]

### [Great psychology experiments][25]

It's no big surprise that other people aren't quite what they seem. But the astonishing finding from
modern psychology is that even our own minds are strange and complex things we don't fully
understand.

[Experiment exposing organisms to blue excitation lighting]

### [What is science—and why does it matter?][26]

From atoms and cells to nuclear power plants and the human brain, the scope of science is truly
amazing. But what exactly is the scientific method... and why is it still our best hope for making
sense of the world?

[Gray plastic Hitachi transistor radio]

### [History of communication][27]

How did we get from the alphabet to the Internet in a few thousand years? Follow the story of shared
information from cuneiform and hieroglyphs, through radio and TV, to streaming media and the Web.

## Most popular

These are some more of our classic, ever-popular articles:

[Photo of red tractor spraying crops with pesticide or insecticide.]

### [Water pollution][28]

Rivers and seas take a long time to recover from the effects of careless human treatment. What
causes pollution and what can we do to stop it?

# Types of Wood: A Guide to Wood Species, Uses, and Characteristics

Understanding the different **types of wood** is essential for choosing the right material for
furniture, construction, woodworking, flooring, cabinetry, and specialty projects. From durable
hardwoods and practical softwoods to engineered wood products, each category offers different
strengths, grain patterns, working properties, and ideal uses.

This guide is designed for woodworkers, builders, designers, furniture makers, and anyone
researching **wood species** for real-world applications. If you want deeper technical data,
species-by-species comparisons, and Janka hardness information, you can also explore our complete
[Wood Database][17].

[[Professional lumber identification workspace with hardwood and softwood samples and technical
specifications]][18]*Choosing the right type of wood starts with understanding how species differ in
appearance, durability, and workability.*

## The Three Main Types of Wood

Most wood materials used in construction, furniture making, and woodworking fall into three broad
groups: **hardwoods**, **softwoods**, and **engineered wood products**. Knowing how these categories
differ is the foundation of better material selection.

### Hardwoods

**Hardwoods** come from deciduous trees, also known as angiosperms. They are often chosen for
furniture, cabinetry, millwork, flooring, and decorative woodworking because of their density, wear
resistance, and attractive grain. In our species library, examples of premium or specialty hardwoods
include [Teak][19], [Purpleheart Wood][20], [Wenge Wood][21], [Cocobolo][22], [Sapele][23], [Curly
Maple][24], [Mango Wood][25], and [Olive Wood][26].

### Softwoods

**Softwoods** come from coniferous trees, also called gymnosperms. They are commonly used in
structural framing, general-purpose construction, exterior work, millwork, and cost-effective
woodworking. Softwoods tend to dominate building applications because of their availability,
predictable dimensions, and value.

### Engineered Wood Products

**Engineered wood** includes manufactured products such as plywood, MDF, OSB, hardboard, and other
panel materials. These products are designed for dimensional consistency, sheet-format efficiency,
and cost control in furniture making, cabinetry, subfloors, wall systems, and interior construction.

## Hardwood vs Softwood: What Really Matters?

The difference between **hardwood vs softwood** is botanical, not simply a measure of hardness. Some
softwoods are strong enough for framing and structural work, while some hardwoods are chosen more
for appearance and finishing quality than for extreme durability. In practice, the right type of
wood depends on the intended use, the environment, the required strength, and the desired look.

Hardwoods are usually preferred for visible surfaces, fine furniture, luxury interiors, and
long-lasting millwork. Softwoods dominate framing, siding, decking, and other construction uses
where structural efficiency and availability matter. Engineered wood products often make the most
sense when large panels, stable dimensions, or budget control are priorities.

# Gemini Industries, Inc.

An employee-owned company

Gemini Industries, Inc. specializes in manufacturing high-quality, innovative wood coatings for
distributors, professional wood finishers and consumers.

[ Learn More ][44]

## EMPLOYEE-OWNED MEANS PRIDE OF OWNERSHIP

Gemini Industries, Inc. is a dynamic manufacturer of innovative, high-quality wood finishes and
coatings. Founded in 1964, Gemini has grown from a local business to an international supplier,
making its mark serving distributors, manufacturers and professional wood finishers. Gemini became
100% employee-owned in 2003, providing employees with a stake in the company’s success that is seen
through enhanced motivation, productivity, accountability and dedication.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT US ][45]

Powered by more than 185 employee-owners

Wood finishing products for interior, exterior and real wood flooring applications

Network of 7 manufacturing and supply locations across the U.S.

Full range of production equipment and raw material and product storage on-site

Two centrally-located manufacturing, shipping and laboratory facilities

Multiple environmental, health and safety (EHS) awards

## Are You Ready to Transform Your Business?

Gemini Industries, Inc. not only provides high-quality, technologically advanced coatings for wood,
but also the technical knowledge and support to guide you to a more efficient, profitable business.

An employee-owned company

Gemini Industries, Inc. specializes in manufacturing high-quality, innovative wood coatings for
distributors, professional wood finishers and consumers.

[ Learn More ][44]

## EMPLOYEE-OWNED MEANS PRIDE OF OWNERSHIP

Gemini Industries, Inc. is a dynamic manufacturer of innovative, high-quality wood finishes and
coatings. Founded in 1964, Gemini has grown from a local business to an international supplier,
making its mark serving distributors, manufacturers and professional wood finishers. Gemini became
100% employee-owned in 2003, providing employees with a stake in the company’s success that is seen
through enhanced motivation, productivity, accountability and dedication.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT US ][45]

Powered by more than 185 employee-owners

Wood finishing products for interior, exterior and real wood flooring applications

Network of 7 manufacturing and supply locations across the U.S.

Full range of production equipment and raw material and product storage on-site

Two centrally-located manufacturing, shipping and laboratory facilities

Multiple environmental, health and safety (EHS) awards

## Are You Ready to Transform Your Business?

Gemini Industries, Inc. not only provides high-quality, technologically advanced coatings for wood,
but also the technical knowledge and support to guide you to a more efficient, profitable business.

[ LEARN MORE ][46]

## Gemini Brands

Gemini offers a complete line of wood finishing products and support materials for both interior and
exterior applications as well as real wood flooring.

scope review to final sign-off.

**01. Quote and scope:** On-site assessment, clear inclusions, timeline, and product system.

skilled home painter in Toronto accounts for those differences before a brush touches the wall.

floors are protected before any work starts. Surface repairs, caulking, and priming are completed
before the finish coat. Most occupied homes are painting room by room to minimize disruption. See

# Your system supplier for industrial coatings

We provide comprehensive **industrial coatings and varnish systems** for all surfaces and the
highest standards of the most demanding industries. Our assortment includes** liquid
coatings** and **powder coatings**, **e-coats**,** gelcoats**, as well as** industrial sealants and
adhesives**.

Take, for instance, the application process for a construction vehicle: Multiple coating systems are
seamlessly utilized across various surfaces and components during horizontal coating. Ensuring a
flawless match in colour, surface finish, gloss level, and aging properties is fundamental for
manufacturers.

# Your system supplier for industrial coatings

coatings** and **powder coatings**, **e-coats**,** gelcoats**, as well as** industrial sealants and

Take, for instance, the application process for a construction vehicle: Multiple coating systems are
seamlessly utilized across various surfaces and components during horizontal coating. Ensuring a
flawless match in colour, surface finish, gloss level, and aging properties is fundamental for
manufacturers.

KRYTEX AT SEMA SHOW 2023
Recognized worldwide: the KRYTEX brand was presented at SEMA SHOW 2023, one of the largest
automotive trade shows from October 31 to November 3, 2023 in Las Vegas (USA)!
[READ MORE ][66]
OUR
MISSION
We see our mission as protecting every surface with our coatings, making the use of material objects
easier and more enjoyable.
All our products are known for their innovation, but one stands out among the rest: our famous top
coat, MEGA 10. We have managed to add non-organic glass to the composition, which makes it unique.

Available exclusively for select dealers and highly professional detailers, following a special
explanatory course.
MEGA 10
TRY ONCE, USE ALWAYS
Titanium protective coating for paintwork

* Protects paint from fading and maintains its natural color
* Decreases the possibility of chipping
* Reduces risks of corrosion development
* Minimizes the risk of paintwork damage at car wash stations using low-grade chemical products and
  low-skilled personnel
* Creates an anti-graffiti effect when two layers are applied
* Enhances shine, depth and intensity of paintwork color
ADVANTAGES OF OUR COATINGS
* **Ease of Application**
  All KRYTEX™ coatings are easy and quick to apply.
* **Quick Multi-Layer Application**
  It is possible to create a multi-layered coating in the shortest possible time for maximum effect
* Long-Lasting Protection
  Our coatings offer guaranteed long-term surface protection, eliminating the need for regular
  renewal
* Chemical Resistance
  Our coatings offer guaranteed resistance to high-potency chemical exposure
* Mechanical Impact Resistance
  Our coatings provide guaranteed resistance to significant mechanical impact during normal car
  maintenance
* Certified Quality
  We have all the official documents confirming the stated features of our coatings
Our products are designed for detailing professionals, and we are confident that our future partners
and dealers are knowledgeable about detailing and protective coatings application.

Nevertheless, our coatings have some unique features that need to be understood before the
application process begins.

For everyone who starts working with KRYTEX™, we provide a special explanatory course to help you
achieve maximum results in detailing. We offer two options: a 2-day course for beginners and a 1-day
course for detailers with experience in protective coatings application.
KRYTEX™
PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE
KRYTEX™ sales strategy is straightforward – we only sell our coatings to our partners and
distributors. Partners (typically detailers) use KRYTEX™ products exclusively for themselves or
their customers, while distributors are entitled to resell to other companies.

We are always interested in widening of our network, so we are inviting new partners and
distributors to join our team!
To receive the conditions of becoming a partner or a distributor, please send us a message to
[info@krytexgroup.com][67] and our managers will provide you with necessary information. Join our
team!

more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured

# Professional Coating Systems

Die MIPA SE zählt zu den weltweit größten und erfolgreichsten familiengeführten Unternehmen der
Lack- und Farbenbranche. Am Hauptsitz in Essenbach und an sieben weiteren europäischen Standorten
entwickeln und produzieren Unternehmen der Mipa Gruppe Beschichtungssysteme für verschiedenste
Anwendungsbereiche.

Neben Fahrzeugreparaturlacken, Lacken für die Industrie und Bautenfarben umfasst das Mipa
Produktsortiment auch Holz- und Schreinerlacke sowie Lackierzubehör für professionelle Anwender.

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig und beliefert eigene Niederlassungen
sowie Partner in über 100 Ländern auf allen Kontinenten.

## Mipa Produktsortiment

Lösungen für alle Anforderungen

Die Entwicklung und Herstellung hochwertiger Lacke für den Fahrzeugreparaturbereich, industrielle
Anwendungen sowie Holzoberflächen und Bauten ist unsere Kernkompetenz. Dank zahlreicher Synergien
innerhalb dieser Geschäftsbereiche bieten wir viele Zusatz- und Ergänzungsprodukte sowie
individuelle Problemlösungen an, um alle Kunden umfassend bedienen zu können.

## Showroom

Entdecken Sie neue Produkte und verschiedene Themenbereiche
rund um das Mipa Komplettsortiment.

[Mehr erfahren][56]

## Bleiben Sie up-to-date

Wir verstehen uns nicht nur als Anbieter eines Komplettsortiments, sondern unterstützen und
begleiten unsere Kunden auch bei allen Schritten des Lackierprozesses. Mit Schulungen in unserem
Schulungszentrum am Hauptsitz in Essenbach sowie an sechs weiteren Trainingszentren weltweit, welche
auch individuell nach Ihren Vorstellungen geplant werden können, bleiben Sie immer auf dem neuesten
Stand der Dinge und lernen frühzeitig, welche neuen Technologien wichtig sind, was im Trend ist und
wie noch weiter für effizientes Arbeiten in der Lackierkabine gesorgt werden kann.

Im Downloadbereich bieten wir mit unseren Produktkatalogen sowie Flyern, Broschüren und Videos auch
viele andere Möglichkeiten, um sich gezielt über MIPA und das gesamte Produktsortiment zu
informieren.

[Schulungen][57]

### Karriere

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig. Das Engagement und Wissen aller
Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ist die Basis für unseren Erfolg. Deshalb steht ein respektvolles
und offenes Miteinander für uns an oberster Stelle.

Ob [Ausbildung][60], [Werkstudententätigkeit][61], [Abschlussarbeit][62] oder [Festanstellung][63] –
MIPA bietet zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für einen heimatnahen Karriereeinstieg.

# Professional Coating Systems

Die MIPA SE zählt zu den weltweit größten und erfolgreichsten familiengeführten Unternehmen der
Lack- und Farbenbranche. Am Hauptsitz in Essenbach und an sieben weiteren europäischen Standorten
entwickeln und produzieren Unternehmen der Mipa Gruppe Beschichtungssysteme für verschiedenste
Anwendungsbereiche.

Neben Fahrzeugreparaturlacken, Lacken für die Industrie und Bautenfarben umfasst das Mipa
Produktsortiment auch Holz- und Schreinerlacke sowie Lackierzubehör für professionelle Anwender.

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig und beliefert eigene Niederlassungen
sowie Partner in über 100 Ländern auf allen Kontinenten.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Welcome to Mohawk

#### The Original Touch-Up Company™

 

When you need products that work as hard as you do, you need Mohawk.

Trusted by pros since 1948, we deliver touch-up and repair solutions for wood and leather that
protect your product and your reputation. 

From markers and aerosols to pigments and polishes, our products are professional-grade *and*
user-friendly, saving you time and money on every job. 

And when you want to sharpen your skills or train your team, our industry-leading workshops are here
to support you.

Speak with an expert today to learn more. 

 

*It has come to our attention that fraudulent coupons are circulating on the internet for purchases
made through our website. We are working to have them removed. Please be aware these are fraudulent
and not valid coupons from Mohawk Finishing Products.

# Welcome to Mohawk

#### The Original Touch-Up Company™

 

When you need products that work as hard as you do, you need Mohawk.

Trusted by pros since 1948, we deliver touch-up and repair solutions for wood and leather that
protect your product and your reputation. 

From markers and aerosols to pigments and polishes, our products are professional-grade *and*
user-friendly, saving you time and money on every job. 

And when you want to sharpen your skills or train your team, our industry-leading workshops are here
to support you.

Speak with an expert today to learn more. 

 

*It has come to our attention that fraudulent coupons are circulating on the internet for purchases
made through our website. We are working to have them removed. Please be aware these are fraudulent
and not valid coupons from Mohawk Finishing Products.

## 
## Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine

Following the closing of the acquisition of the Sika European Industrial Coatings Business, we are
pleased to present our new website in the Sherwin-Williams corporate design.

Founded in 1866, Sherwin-Williams is a leading global paint and coatings manufacturer with 64,000+
employees across 120+ countries. In its 150-year-plus history, Sherwin-Williams has been committed
to enhancing our customers’ operations and accelerating their business growth with innovative,
high-performance coating solutions, world-class industry expertise, and unparalleled technical,
specification and commercial service.

Supported by 12 factories and nine research and development centres across Europe, the
Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Division delivers smart asset protection to customers in a wide
array of markets, including Oil & Gas, Water & Wastewater, Bridge & Highway, Steel Fabrication,
Flooring, Food & Beverage, Mining, Rail, Marine, Power Generation and Fire Protection. From alkyds
to zincs, Sherwin-Williams offers a complete line of time-tested, high-performance coatings and
systems to combat corrosion, supported by the largest group of NACE-certified coating inspectors in
the industry.

Our customers and partners will continue to enjoy the established relationships with their
knowledgeable Sika Industrial Coatings team members, and gain additional benefits that come with
becoming part of the Sherwin-Williams family. This includes access to a global team of leading
industry experts, an expanded portfolio of high-performance coatings, a broad array of specification
approvals, and an unparalleled distribution network worldwide.

We look forward to the opportunity to serve you and your company’s asset protection needs.

## 
## Rebranding of our Product Portfolio

After the transfer of operations of the business unit Industrial Coatings from Sika to
Sherwin-Williams, a renaming of our complete product range became necessary.
* The change of product names along the Sherwin-Williams product naming system does not have any
  impact on the formulation of our coating materials.
* The products will therefore continue to be produced with the same raw materials, according to the
  same recipes and in the same manufacturing process in the expected quality and have the same
  technical data as known since then.

Get more information as well as an overview of the reason and scope of this project by clicking on
the button below.

## 
## Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine

Following the closing of the acquisition of the Sika European Industrial Coatings Business, we are
pleased to present our new website in the Sherwin-Williams corporate design.

Founded in 1866, Sherwin-Williams is a leading global paint and coatings manufacturer with 64,000+
employees across 120+ countries. In its 150-year-plus history, Sherwin-Williams has been committed
to enhancing our customers’ operations and accelerating their business growth with innovative,
high-performance coating solutions, world-class industry expertise, and unparalleled technical,
specification and commercial service.

Supported by 12 factories and nine research and development centres across Europe, the
Sherwin-Williams Protective & Marine Division delivers smart asset protection to customers in a wide
array of markets, including Oil & Gas, Water & Wastewater, Bridge & Highway, Steel Fabrication,
Flooring, Food & Beverage, Mining, Rail, Marine, Power Generation and Fire Protection. From alkyds
to zincs, Sherwin-Williams offers a complete line of time-tested, high-performance coatings and
systems to combat corrosion, supported by the largest group of NACE-certified coating inspectors in
the industry.

Our customers and partners will continue to enjoy the established relationships with their
knowledgeable Sika Industrial Coatings team members, and gain additional benefits that come with
becoming part of the Sherwin-Williams family. This includes access to a global team of leading
industry experts, an expanded portfolio of high-performance coatings, a broad array of specification
approvals, and an unparalleled distribution network worldwide.

We look forward to the opportunity to serve you and your company’s asset protection needs.

## 
## Rebranding of our Product Portfolio

After the transfer of operations of the business unit Industrial Coatings from Sika to
Sherwin-Williams, a renaming of our complete product range became necessary.
* The change of product names along the Sherwin-Williams product naming system does not have any
  impact on the formulation of our coating materials.
* The products will therefore continue to be produced with the same raw materials, according to the
  same recipes and in the same manufacturing process in the expected quality and have the same
  technical data as known since then.

Get more information as well as an overview of the reason and scope of this project by clicking on
the button below.

[ Salone 2026, il design torna reale: materiali, imperfezioni e gerarchie del colore ][193]
Salone 2026 segna un cambio di paradigma: il design torna alla materia, alla sua verità e alla sua
capacità di generare valore. Superfici imperfette, legni naturali e palette sofisticate raccontano
un equilibrio nuovo tra tecnologia e dimensione umana. In questo scenario, anche la vernice evolve:
non più copertura, ma strumento progettuale che interpreta e valorizza.
[Aprile 22, 2026][194]
[ Il welfare Renner raccontato dalla tv franco-tedesca Arte ][195]

At RK Paint & Coats, we are committed to delivering products/services of the highest quality. Our
unwavering dedication to excellence ensures that every customer receives nothing but the best.

### ISO 9001:2015 Certified Company

Our company is proud to be an ISO 9001:2015 certified organization. This certification reflects our
commitment to maintaining a high standard of quality management systems, ensuring the delivery of
products/services that consistently meet customer requirements and regulatory standards.

### Flexible Schedule Options

We believe that a thriving workforce is one that finds harmony between professional and personal
life. That's why we are proud to offer flexible schedule options, empowering our employees to take
control of their workdays and enhance their overall well-being.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

[sanchar saathi portal]

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## The official procurement platform of the UN system

As [mandated by the General Assembly][17], all organizations of the UN are encouraged to participate
in UNGM with a view of creating one common United Nations global procurement website.
* Access a database of more than 500,000 suppliers and individual consultants
* Publish opportunities and contract awards
* Perform due diligence, ensure suppliers are not on sanction lists
* Share and piggyback on Long-Term Agreements (LTA)
* Integrate your organization's procurement system with UNGM

Are you from an international organization (IO), not part of the UN System, but formed by treaty
under international law with its own legal personality?

* Share and access global procurement insights on our Knowledge Center

* Organize international procurement seminars with our event management module
* Showcase innovative solutions from your country

## See how we make it

Every panel we ship passes through these 12 steps on our own production lines — from log selection
to container loading.

[See our full 12-step process ][27]
[
[Log selection & peeling — Vinawood production process]

### Log selection & peeling

Incoming hardwood and softwood logs are graded by species, diameter, and moisture, then rotated
against a knife to produce continuous veneer sheets (0.3–2.5 mm).

][28]
[
[Veneer drying & storage — Vinawood production process]

### Veneer drying & storage

Veneer sheets are dried to 8–12% moisture content in continuous roller or jet dryers, then stacked
and acclimatised in the storage area before layup.

][29]
[
[Gluing & lay-up — Vinawood production process]

### Gluing & lay-up

Adhesive (phenol-formaldehyde for exterior, urea-formaldehyde for interior) is metered onto core
veneers and the cross-grain stack is assembled for pressing.

][30]
[
[Cold press — Vinawood production process]

### Cold press

The assembled panel is pressed at ambient temperature to set the glue-line and consolidate the stack
before it enters the hot press.

][31]
[
[Hot press — Vinawood production process]

### Hot press

Panels are cured under heat (120–150°C) and pressure (10–14 kg/cm²) to fully bond the laminations
into a single rigid board.

][32]
[
[Surfacing with putty — Vinawood production process]

### Surfacing with putty

Small open defects, knots, and splits on the face veneers are filled with wood putty to deliver a
uniform surface for sanding and lamination.

][33]
[
[Sanding — Vinawood production process]

### Sanding

Surfaces are calibrated and finish-sanded to the target grit for the end application — structural,
furniture, or film-faced.

][34]
[
[Trimming — Vinawood production process]

### Trimming

Finished panels are cut to exact nominal size and squared to final dimensions before inspection.

][35]
[
[Surface lamination — Vinawood production process]

### Surface lamination

For film-faced, melamine, or overlay products, the finished sheet or film is hot-pressed onto one or
both faces of the panel.

][36]
[
[QC inspection — Vinawood production process]

### QC inspection

Every panel is inspected for bond strength, moisture content, face defects, and dimensional accuracy
against the target grade.

][37]
[
[Edge sealing — Vinawood production process]

### Edge sealing

Edges are sealed with water-resistant paint to block moisture ingress and panels are branded with
product + traceability marks.

][38]
[
[Packaging & shipping — Vinawood production process]

### Packaging & shipping

Approved panels are strapped into bundles, wrapped against weather, and loaded into containers for
sea or land freight.

][39]
[See our full 12-step process][40]

Does India have anti-dumping duties on plywood?+

Is BIS certification mandatory for plywood imports to India?+

What plywood products does Vinawood manufacture?+

How many plywood sheets fit in a 40HC container?+

## Do-it-yourself

Do you want to design your home? Whether spraying, rolling or removing wallpaper - get to know our
products in the DIY sector.

[Do-it-yourself][236]

## Contractor

Discover all possibilities of machine application of paints, lacquers, plasters and more with
WAGNER! You will appreciate the advantages!

[Contractor][237]
[Wagner Group Industrie Produktion]

## Industry

WAGNER is a leading global supplier of systems and components in industrial surface technology with
extensive experience in many sectors.

[Industry][238]

# WAGNER - Innovative coating technology for perfect surfaces

Industry, trade and DIY - our customers benefit from comprehensive WAGNER know-how and our many
years of experience in coating technology for surface finishing. For industrial applications we
offer innovative systems for wet paint and powder coating. Craftsmen use our reliable and economical
equipment in operation with various technologies such as Airless to apply paint and plaster. WAGNER
has developed a whole range of user-friendly renovation products for DIY enthusiasts. Surface
technology from WAGNER convinces with innovations, quality and efficiency.


[W590 indoor application wall half total]

### Do-it-yourself

You would like to refresh your walls and ceilings with colour or redesign them? You want to paint
your doors, furniture in house and garden or your fence? Realize your ideas around the topic color
paint completely after your personal taste. You have fun with it, but also you want Then you are
always right with products from WAGNER.

[Do-it-yourself][239]
[otica wagner rohbau ps3 5329]

### Contractor

The WAGNER range offers you as a craftsman the suitable sprayer for almost every material. We stand
for quality and innovation when it comes to perfect coating! Would you like to use dispersion,
lacquers, facade paints or heavy materials? Whether painter, carpenter or plasterer: WAGNER tools
guarantee every craftsman a perfect surface.

[Contractor][240]
[PIC EQU TOPFINISH Bell 1S ECH EMO 002]

### Industry

With the Industrial Solutions division, WAGNER is one of the world’s leading suppliers of systems
and components in industrial surface technology with extensive experience in a wide range of
sectors.Whether surfaces for wood workpieces, plastic and metal components in vehicles, durable
corrosion protection or domestic appliances - we offer the ideal solution for your individual
application.

## Industry

WAGNER is a leading global supplier of systems and components in industrial surface technology with

# WAGNER - Innovative coating technology for perfect surfaces

Industry, trade and DIY - our customers benefit from comprehensive WAGNER know-how and our many
years of experience in coating technology for surface finishing. For industrial applications we
offer innovative systems for wet paint and powder coating. Craftsmen use our reliable and economical
equipment in operation with various technologies such as Airless to apply paint and plaster. WAGNER
has developed a whole range of user-friendly renovation products for DIY enthusiasts. Surface
technology from WAGNER convinces with innovations, quality and efficiency.


[W590 indoor application wall half total]

### Do-it-yourself

You would like to refresh your walls and ceilings with colour or redesign them? You want to paint
your doors, furniture in house and garden or your fence? Realize your ideas around the topic color
paint completely after your personal taste. You have fun with it, but also you want Then you are
always right with products from WAGNER.

The WAGNER range offers you as a craftsman the suitable sprayer for almost every material. We stand
for quality and innovation when it comes to perfect coating! Would you like to use dispersion,
lacquers, facade paints or heavy materials? Whether painter, carpenter or plasterer: WAGNER tools
guarantee every craftsman a perfect surface.

# Guide for Wood Types, Characteristics and Lumber Identification

Wood is a fibrous and porous structural tissue of wood trees and other woody plants. This organic
material made from **natural cellulose fibers** is found in their roots and stems, growing upward to
the tops of their canopy. The main physical characteristic of wood fibers is their **strong
tension** created both by their natural strength and the way the fibers are embedded in a matrix
that effectively resists compression. Wood plays an essential supporting role in a living tree – it
enables all woody plants to have a strong structure to grow and reach more sunlight than surrounding
plant life, elevating their fruit from the easy reach of animals. Also, it conveys nutrients and
water between the roots and canopy.

Wood covers the secondary xylem of the stems of trees and can also include many other types of plant
tissues with very similar structures and comparable properties (including the roots or others) or
even engineered material from wood, wood chips, or fiber.

Even before the creation of the earliest human civilizations, wood was extensively used by our
ancestors as a **fuel for fire, as construction material, for making tools, furniture, and
weapons**, and as a source from which other useful form factors (**paper**) or **chemical
compounds** could be extracted (such as purified **cellulose, cellphone**, and others).

Today, wood is used worldwide as one of the **most popular carbon-neutral renewable resources** used
in many industries, most notably in the building construction and furniture industry. The experts

enables all woody plants to have a strong structure to grow and reach more sunlight than surrounding
plant life, elevating their fruit from the easy reach of animals. Also, it conveys nutrients and
water between the roots and canopy.

Wood covers the secondary xylem of the stems of trees and can also include many other types of plant
tissues with very similar structures and comparable properties (including the roots or others) or
even engineered material from wood, wood chips, or fiber.

Even before the creation of the earliest human civilizations, wood was extensively used by our
ancestors as a **fuel for fire, as construction material, for making tools, furniture, and
weapons**, and as a source from which other useful form factors (**paper**) or **chemical
compounds** could be extracted (such as purified **cellulose, cellphone**, and others).

Today, wood is used worldwide as one of the **most popular carbon-neutral renewable resources** used
in many industries, most notably in the building construction and furniture industry. The experts
reported that out of 434 billion cubic meters of worldwide forests, up to 47% are currently being
exploited commercially.

## Types of Wood

structure, tree species, and **processing can lead to the different characteristics of the finished
products**. While many woodworkers focus on things like **tension, weight, durability, and ease of

**hardness can vary between them**, leading to hardwoods with very soft wood structures and
softwoods with very hard, strong, and durable.

## Hardwood

**Hardwood trees** are usually regarded as **premium types of wood**. They come from trees that,
most of the time, have **prolonged growth and very dense cellulose fiber structure**. While the wood
harvested from the hardwood trees is usually **tough to be processed** due to its hardness, the
finished products can **withstand time and outdoor elements** much better than those created from
less durable softwoods.

than other types of wood. They also often have very strong wood density, which is closely connected
with the particular species of tree that yielded it. The densest type of hardwood is African black
ironwood (Olea capensis).

### Types of Hardwood

While the most famous (and most expensive) type of hardwood is mahogany, other types are also very
well represented on the worldwide market, including:
* **Oak** - The staple of the woodworking industry. The reliable hardwood can be used for almost any
  application, both indoors and outdoors.
* **Maple** - High-quality hardwood that can elevate the visual impact of any room. They are used
  extensively for both furniture and high-end objects.
* **[Basswood][6]** - Hardwood of great acoustic quality, commonly found in musical instruments,
  carvings, and lumber products.
* **[Ipe Wood][7]** - Ipe is known for its durability, which is why it can today be found in
  flooring, paneling, and objects that must endure a lot of usages (door handles, tool handles, and
  others).
* **Cherry wood** – Chery hardwood is excellent for construction, flooring, furniture, and creating
  smaller, durable objects and specialty wood items.
* **[Olive wood][8]** – Cream or yellowish-brown olive wood is used today to create high-end and
  stylish furniture, art objects, and expensive small specialty wood items.
* **[Wenge wood][9]** – Black stripes that flow across the medium brown, yellowish and reddish hues
  of wenge are praised for their acoustic properties in musical instruments. Still, this hardwood is
  also used in furniture, paneling, veneer, and turned objects.
* **Walnut wood** – Wood from wide varieties of walnut trees can be used to create a wide array of
  products, including furniture, paneling, and small turned objects.
* **[Teak][10]** - Golden or medium brown hardwood of Teak is praised worldwide for its excellent
  durability, strength, and visual appeal. Also used in indoor and outdoor applications, it is
  regularly used in boatbuilding.
* **[Cocobolo][11]** – An incredibly diverse variety of Cocobolo hardwood (including orange, yellow,
  red, and brown shades) has found popularity worldwide in musical instruments, fine furniture, and
  small specialty items. The worldwide supply of Cocobolo is currently very limited.
* **[Curly Maple][12]** - Moderately-priced maple hardwood is durable and versatile, enabling it to
  be regularly used for flooring, furniture, musical instruments, and an incredible variety of
  wooden objects.
* **Rosewood** – Dark and visually rich hardwood of rosewood is famous for its top-of-the-line decay
  resilience, making it the perfect material for building high-end furniture, flooring, musical
  instruments, and turned objects. Rosewood is very expensive, and several South American
  governments closely regulate its trade.
* **[Sapele][13]** – This famous tropical African hardwood with golden to dark reddish-brown hues
  was regularly used in boatbuilding, flooring, furniture, and the creation of musical instruments.
  Still, in recent years its trade was severely limited due to overexploitation.
* **Teak** – Teak is one of the most popular sources of highly-durable and versatile hardwood in the
  modern woodworking and processing industry. Originally found in Asia, today, plantations of teak
  can be found across tropical regions of Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
* **[Mango wood][14]** – Famous moderately-durable hardwood tree of Tropical Asia and Oceania is a
  traditional source of wood for Hawaiian and Pacific ukuleles, furniture, and turning objects.
* **Mahogany** – The undisputed king of hardwoods. Its incredible visual appeal and strong
  properties have made it a highly sought-after source for creating high-end furniture, fine
  instruments, art objects, and other specialty wood items.

## Softwood

**Softwood trees** (any three that are producing not leaves, but cones) are regarded to produce
**mid and low-tier quality wood** that can be used for the creation of wooden objects and furniture
with several **limitations regarding their durability, strength, and endurance** of the final
product. While the hardness can vary from very soft to hard, **most softwoods indeed feature lower
density internal structure, making them light and easy to process**.

Visually, softwood trees have an internal structure that is **paler than hardwoods**. Since the
worldwide market has placed great attention on darker wood types, this often paints softwood
products ‘inferior’ to hardwood.

### Types of Softwood

While softwoods can be used in construction, furniture manufacture, and more, one of the largest use
case scenarios is in producing manufactured wood – chipboard, fiberboard, and plywood.

Here are the most popular types of softwood:
* **Pine** – Pines come in various densities and strengths, making them suitable for creating an
  incredible variety of indoor and outdoor objects, including construction, wood pulp production,
  ornamental uses, etc.
* **Spruce** - It is one of the most commonly evergreen trees in the Pinaceae family, known for its
  timber versatility. Since it lacks durability against insect attacks, wooden objects made from
  spruce wood are extensively used only indoors.
* **Cedar** – Cedars are the most common softwoods in the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean
  and Himalayas. They are used to create objects (such as chests) that are durable against insects
  and moths. They are also used for the production of unique cedar wood shoes.
* **Fir** – Evergreen Fir trees can grow to the impressive 80m in height, making their softwood
  highly sought after for manufacturing industrial timber, pulp, and plywood. Similarly, like many
  other softwood trees, Fir wood has very poor insect resistance, making it usable only in indoor
  environments.
* **Larch** – Native to colder parts of the northern hemisphere and one of the most commonly
  evergreen trees of Siberia and Canada, the wood of these trees is widely praised for its
  durability, strength, and waterproofing, which make it excellent for the production of outdoor
  furniture, support beams, boatbuilding, and both indoor and outdoor flooring and paneling.
* **Western hemlock** – Originating from western Alaska, the timber of this large evergreen
  coniferous tree is often used to create pallets, boxes, plywood, and other construction objects.
* **Yew** – Yew is a type of softwood with strong density and often strong rot resistance, making it
  suitable for producing a wide variety of wooden objects, including furniture, cabinets, musical
  instruments, turned objects, and archery bows.
